_about: Starter courses shown on the teacher hub and student phones. Each course has numbered units; assignments belong to a unit. Teachers can add and change courses on the hub; the hub copy wins after a change. Ids must stay the same once in use: rename the title, not the id. 'read' is what the unit's 'Find readings' link searches for in the phone's library. 'comingSoon' shows the course greyed out.

courses.title: Mathematics
courses.description: Numbers, fractions, measurement and data: the maths used every day.

courses.title: Science
courses.description: Living things, the Earth and its weather, and energy and forces.
